# Worm, phase 3: splat fit (run after p2_form.txt; see worm.spec.md). The feeler tips sink 2 cm,
# the whole worm stretches 6 % along its length about the head's centre. Generated by make_worm.py.
select Head
active Head
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.25"
translate 0 0 -0.02
mode object
select all
cursor set 0 0 0
scale 1 1.06 1 --pivot cursor
apply --scale
inspect stats
export worm.glb
